padEmails: Keep Stripe's pre-authorized debit emails on (Stripe Dashboard → Settings → Business → Customer emails: Send Canada PAD mandate, debit initiation, and microdeposit verification emails). They send your members the mandate confirmation and debit notices.
title: Go-live
help: Run alongside your old system until you are ready. Billing, member emails and member texts stay off until you turn them on here.
memberSmsHelp: Allow texts to members who have consented. Save an SMS provider first. The daily cap in SMS settings limits send attempts; owner test texts are exempt.
smsProviderRequired: Save a working SMS provider in Settings before turning member texts on.
smsProviderReadFailed: The SMS provider could not be checked. Try turning member texts on again.
paymentsReadFailed: Stripe could not be checked. Try turning billing on again.
check.sms_ready.ready: Text delivery is configured. Members must consent before receiving texts.
check.sms_ready.needs_attention: Member texts cannot be sent. Save a working SMS provider or turn member texts off.
check.sms_ready.not_applicable: Member texts are off and no SMS provider is configured.
check.sms_ready.unreadable: The saved SMS settings could not be read. Replace or remove them in Settings.
check.sms_ready.read_failed: SMS readiness could not be checked. Refresh the checklist to try again.
billingHelp: Allow automatic collection, retries and staff card charges. Turning billing off pauses new charges; payments already started at Stripe can still complete.
memberEmailsHelp: Send receipts, payment reminders, card-expiry notices and signed links. Staff invitations, security emails and owner alerts continue while this is off.
check.members_imported.needs_attention: Import your members or add them by hand.
check.schedule_ready.ready: Your class schedule is set up.
check.schedule_ready.needs_attention: Add your classes to the schedule.
check.stripe_ready.read_failed: Stripe could not be checked. Check the saved keys in Settings → Integrations → Payments.
check.cards_collected.not_applicable: No paid memberships to collect yet, or payments are not configured.
check.cards_collected.ready: Every household with a paid membership has a saved default card.
check.cards_collected.needs_attention: Some households with paid memberships need a saved default card.
check.waivers_signed.not_applicable: No active members or current waiver templates to check.
check.waivers_signed.ready: Active members have signed every current waiver and agreement.
check.waivers_signed.needs_attention: Some active members still need to sign a current waiver or agreement.
check.online_joining.ready: Visitors can join and pay online at /join.
check.online_joining.needs_attention: Visitors see “Online joining is not available right now” at /join.
check.online_joining.stripe: Connect Stripe in Settings → Integrations → Payments.
check.online_joining.payments_read_faile: Stripe could not be checked: check the saved keys in Settings → Integrations → Payments.
check.online_joining.no_documents: Add a waiver or agreement in Waivers and agreements.
check.online_joining.too_many_documents: Retire documents until at most eight are current.
check.online_joining.no_plans: Add an active plan in the gym's currency.
check.smtp_ready.needs_attention: Configure email delivery so members receive emails.
check.backup_ready.needs_attention: Configure backups before you rely on this app.
check.webhook_ready.ready: Payment notifications have been processed, with none waiting or failed.
check.webhook_ready.needs_attention: Wait for a processed payment notification and resolve any waiting or failed events on the health page.
check.reconciliation_complete.ready: No unresolved payment attempts or refunds remain, and any restored payments have been checked.
check.reconciliation_complete.needs_atte: Resolve pending payment attempts or refunds. A refund reservation that never reached Stripe clears automatically after 23 hours, within the next hourly check. If still blocked after 24 hours, ask an owner or admin to check Stripe and payment reconciliation. After a restore, complete payment reconciliation before resuming billing.
check.past_due_dates.ready: No active membership has a next billing date before today in the gym's timezone.
check.past_due_dates.needs_attention: Review the memberships below before turning billing on.
pastDueHelp: These active memberships have next billing dates before the gym's local today. Billing catches up missed periods. If your old system already collected them, correct their dates before turning billing on to avoid charging twice. Periods more than seven days old are held for review.
confirmDates: I reviewed these dates and confirm these periods have not already been collected by the old system.
confirmEnable: Confirm dates and turn billing on
confirmChanged: Review and confirm the latest past billing dates before turning billing on.
error: The request failed. Please try again.
changed: These settings changed elsewhere. The latest values are shown; try again.
justSaved: Settings were just saved on this page. Check what is shown and try again.
changedUnread: These settings changed elsewhere, so the switch was not changed, and the latest values could not be loaded.
justSavedUnread: Settings were just saved on this page, so the switch was not changed, and the latest values could not be loaded.
timeoutUnread: The save took too long to answer and may still have gone through, and the latest values could not be loaded.
paymentsReadFailedUnread: Stripe could not be checked, so billing was not turned on, and the latest values could not be loaded.
timeout: The save took too long to answer and may still have gone through. Check the switches shown before trying again.
reconcileHelp: After resolving payment issues, check again before turning billing on. This check never turns billing on.
reconcilePending: No completed result for the latest check yet. You can run the check again if it was interrupted.
reconcileWithoutStripe: The last check ran without Stripe and only read restored records. To use Stripe, connect it in Payments, then choose Check restored payments again in Go-live before turning billing back on. Connecting Stripe pauses billing until that check is clear.
reconcileStripeConnected: The last restore check ran without Stripe. Billing is paused. In Go-live, choose Check restored payments again to compare with Stripe. Once the check is clear, turn billing back on.
reconcileStripeUnchecked: Stripe could not be checked, so this check can't tell whether Stripe is connected. Check the saved keys in Settings → Integrations → Payments, then choose Check restored payments again.
reconcileModeChanged: The last check read Stripe {checkedMode} mode. Check restored payments again in {savedMode} mode before turning billing on.
reconcilePause: Pause billing before checking restored payments.
reconcileError: The payment check failed. Billing stays paused. Check your payment configuration and try again.
reconcileTimeout: The payment check is taking longer than this page waits and may still be running. Billing stays paused. Reload this page in a few minutes to see its result.
reconcileBusy: A payment check for this restore is still running. Billing stays paused. Wait for its result, then check again if needed.
unavailable: Go-live settings are not available right now.
